사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: Strengthen the shell-shoulder impact around the front rim and neck root. The current exposed head remains ahead of the rim and the near foreleg reads as a supporting step, so the silhouette does not clearly show a shell bash. Redraw the neck/head tucked back toward the shell, project the leading shoulder/rim farther right, and brace the near foreleg ahead of the body while retaining its grounded sole around y=123. Keep the neck-to-shoulder pixels continuous and preserve the shell volume and gold-groove layout across move, attack and recover.
